The FloPlast 68mm round downpipe in white provides an efficient and durable rainwater drainage solution. This high-quality uPVC system offers a practical, easy to install option for managing water runoff from roofs, making it suitable for both new build projects and refurbishment applications. Its robust uPVC construction and 68mm diameter ensure reliable performance, while the 2.5m length and plain-end design facilitate straightforward installation. Compatible with most major manufacturers' guttering systems, offering flexibility for trade professionals and home renovators.
